gloss: appeal; persuasive power; ability to attract (customers, attention)

definitions.gloss: appeal; persuasive power; ability to attract (customers, attention)
definitions.explanation: The power of a product, advertisement, or message to attract attention and persuade consumers. A marketing and business term widely used in discussions of advertising strategy and branding.

examples.japanese: この{広告|こうこく}は{訴求力|そきゅうりょく}がある。
{訴求力|そきゅうりょく}の{高|たか}いキャッチコピーを{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: To think up a catchy slogan with strong appeal.

examples.japanese: {価格|かかく}だけでなく、{商品|しょうひん}のストーリーで{訴求力|そきゅうりょく}を{高|たか}める{戦略|せんりゃく}が{求|もと}められている。
examples.english: A strategy is needed that boosts appeal not just through price but through the product's story.

notes:
A marketing and business term combining {訴求|そきゅう} (appeal, making a pitch) and {力|りょく} (power). Refers to the ability of a product, message, advertisement, or brand to attract and persuade consumers. Widely used in advertising, marketing, and business strategy discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {訴求力|そきゅうりょく}がある/ない: to have/lack appeal
- {訴求力|そきゅうりょく}を{高|たか}める: to increase appeal
- {訴求力|そきゅうりょく}の{高|たか}い: highly appealing
- {訴求力|そきゅうりょく}に{欠|か}ける: to be lacking in appeal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {魅力|みりょく} — charm; attractiveness (broader, personal or general appeal)
- アピール{力|りょく} — appeal power (loanword version, slightly more casual)
- {説得力|せっとくりょく} — persuasive power (focuses on logical/argumentative persuasion)
- {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく} — ability to attract customers
